 if = { limit = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_MOSUL } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_mosul_yes } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_mosul_no }
 if = { limit = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_BAGHDAD } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_baghdad_yes } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_baghdad_no }
 if = { limit = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_DEIR_EZ_ZOR } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_deir_ez_zor_yes } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_deir_ez_zor_no }
 if = { limit = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_BASRA } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_basra_yes } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_entry_state_basra_no }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_MOSUL } } } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_missing_state_mosul }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_BAGHDAD } } } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_missing_state_baghdad }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_DEIR_EZ_ZOR } } } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_missing_state_deir_ez_zor }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { any_scope_state = { state_region = s:STATE_BASRA } } } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_missing_state_basra }
} }
ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_details = { scope = state effect = {
 if = { limit = { state_region = s:STATE_MOSUL }
  if = { limit = { state_region = s:STATE_MOSUL market_access >= 0.85 turmoil < 0.18 any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_railway level >= 4 } any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_power_plant level >= 3 } } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_region_cmf_state_met } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_region_cmf_state_unmet }
  if = { limit = { market_access >= 0.85 } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_state_mosul_market_access_yes } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_state_mosul_market_access_no }
  if = { limit = { turmoil < 0.18 } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_state_mosul_turmoil_yes } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_state_mosul_turmoil_no }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_railway level >= 4 } } custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_state_mosul_building_railway_yes } else = { custom_tooltip_no_bullet = ffpa_mesopotamian_waterworks_cmf_project_state_mosul_building_railway_no }

 }
